name: Server version banner disclosure
attack_scenario: Attacker reads 'Server: nginx/1.18.0' or an Apache version banner, looks up known CVEs for that exact build, and launches a targeted exploit instead of blind probing.
negative_test_hint: request "/nonexistent-path-probe" and assert the 404 error page and the Server response header omit the nginx/Apache version number

exemplar.explanation: server_tokens on (nginx) and ServerSignature On / ServerTokens Full (Apache) emit the exact server software and version in Server: headers and error pages, handing attackers a precise fingerprint for matching public CVEs. Turning them off (or ServerTokens Prod) reveals only the product name, forcing blind probing instead of targeted exploits.
